bridge.where: The valley of Makkah and the land of Canaan
text: Ibrahim had two sons, and each became a prophet. Ismail, son of Hajar, grew up in the valley of Makkah by the spring of Zamzam. Ishaq, son of Sarah, grew up in Canaan.
Two great families come from them. Ismail's line leads, much later, to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Ishaq's son Yaqub becomes the father of the Children of Israel.
